body: 076 half-wave supplement recorded; the previously missing calculation is now supplied. All 4 newly filed artifact pins and 9 file-source pins match. No independent numerical/source review by Sciences. Report and RESULTS explicitly leave transfer open; standing conditional targets stay 896.818/1030.846 kg/m3.
